title: Customer Retention Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote • UK, France, Spain, Germany or Canada

 About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh)

 Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:

• Predictable performance, even at scale

• Secure, compliant environments by default

• Real-time observability and profiling built in

• Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds

• AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

 The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

 Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

 What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

 Our values:

 We make a positive impact.

 We aim for the stars.

 We care for each other.

 Impact of a Customer Retention Manager

 As our Customer Retention Manager, you play a key role in protecting and growing revenue across a high-volume portfolio of customer accounts. Your day-to-day is proactive, human outreach and health monitoring — building real relationships at scale, bringing a human touch to segments that are often managed purely through automation, and catching risk early. When you manage that well, renewal conversations become a natural next step rather than the main event. You'll also work within the workflows, health scoring, automation, and segmentation that let retention scale without creating internal chaos, all while keeping the renewal experience smart, timely, and low-friction.

 Reporting to our VP, Customer Success, this role is ideal for someone who loves building, improving processes, testing ideas, and seeing direct impact on both customer outcomes and business performance. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Data, and GTM teams to inform retention strategy and engagement models across the business.

 What to expect

•
 Renewal Ownership & Pipeline Management: Manage a rolling pipeline of customer renewals across a high-volume portfolio, initiating conversations ahead of contract expiration and driving each account through to close.

•
 Retention Workflow Support: Help build and improve scalable retention and renewal workflows using Salesforce and integrated tooling, contributing to repeatable processes that hold up as portfolio volume grows.

•
 Proactive Relationship Building: Own direct, human outreach to smaller and long-tail accounts by proactively building relationships with them.

•
 Lifecycle & Tech-Touch Design: Contribute to the design of customer lifecycle journeys, engagement triggers, and tech-touch motions

•
 Health Scoring & Risk Identification: Use customer health scoring frameworks- built on usage, engagement, and lifecycle signals- to identify at-risk accounts early, partnering with internal stakeholders to develop and execute save strategies.

•
 Automation & AI Enablement: Support the implementation of automated outreach, lifecycle campaigns, and renewal risk workflows, and flag opportunities to leverage AI and automation.

•
 Commercial Negotiation: Negotiate pricing, contract terms, and multi-year agreements within established company guidelines.

•
 Expansion Identification: Partner with Customer Success Managers and Account Executives to identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities during the renewal cycle.

•
 Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Data, and GTM teams to support and inform retention strategy and customer engagement models.

 What you bring

•
 Renewal Lifecycle Experience: Experience managing a rolling renewal pipeline, engaging customers well in advance of contract expiration.

•
 Commercial Negotiation Skills: Experience negotiating pricing, contract terms, and multi-year agreements within established guidelines.

•
 Risk Identification & Save Strategy: Ability to identify at-risk accounts early and collaborate cross-functionally on save strategies.

•
 CRM & Systems Experience: Hands-on experience working within Salesforce or a similar CRM, including contributing to operational workflows or lifecycle processes.

•
 Retention & Lifecycle Knowledge: Solid understanding of customer health scoring, lifecycle automation, and retention strategy.

•
 Expansion Mindset: Proven ability to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities in partnership with CSMs and Account Executives.

•
 Versatility: Comfort operating across both customer-facing engagement conversations and systems/process design conversations.

•
 Growth Mindset: Demonstrates a sustained commitment to continuous improvement, actively seeking out better ways to engage customers and support scalable operations.

 Where we hire

 At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in the UK, France, Spain, Germany or Canada . Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

 How we hire

 We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. Few of us would be here had we not taken a chance.

 You can expect 4 video interviews on Google Meet to follow the order below. Should you successfully move through the entire process you will have the opportunity to meet with a variety of Upsunners. Our goal is to ensure you can make the most informed decision on whether this role, and our culture aligns with what you’re looking for in your future working environment.

• 45 Minutes with Talent Acquisition

• 60 Minutes with Hiring Manager (VP, Customer Success)

• 60 Minutes with Team (IC's)

• 45 Minutes with Executive (COO)

 All roles require background checks.

 What we offer

 A product you can believe in - Join us in transforming how businesses build and manage web applications, driven making a positive impact as a proud B Corp .

 An Award-Winning Workplace - We’ve been recognized by Forbes’ Top 30 Companies for Remote Jobs and France’s Best Workplaces for Women.

 ️ A culture that values your voice - Join a flexible, open, and inclusive work environment where your voice is encouraged, and your ideas shape our growth and evolution.

 A global team - Collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds across the world, embracing different perspectives

 Benefits and perks - Make the most of what matters to you

 Flexible PTO

 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (UK, Canada, France, Spain, USA)

 Company stock options

 Professional development budget

 Office equipment budget

 ‍️ Wellness budget

 Annual team gatherings

 Internet reimbursement

 Inclusive parental leave

 ️ Remote work travel program

 You belong here

 At Upsun, we celebrate diversity in all its forms and are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We embrace and value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences, because they make us stronger as a team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, and whatever path you've taken, you are welcome here. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, connect with others, and share your passion. If you need accommodations at any stage of our hiring process, please let us know. We're here to ensure an accessible and comfortable experience for you.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/platform-sh-customer-retention-manager

 Impact of a Billing Systems Architect

 As an Enterprise Billing Systems Architect at Upsun, you are the technical anchor of our billing infrastructure, playing a vital role in ensuring our revenue operations, pricing structures, and financial integrations run seamlessly as our business scales. Picking up primary ownership from our implementation partner, you serve as the dedicated technical lead bridging Finance, Product, and Engineering.

 You’re deeply analytical, systems-minded, and collaborative—someone who thrives on translating complex business, pricing, and accounting rules into reliable system logic. Working downstream from our core engineering and data mediation teams, you ensure the integrity of our Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) platform while continuously optimizing platform performance and automation.

 Beyond day-to-day platform administration, you contribute to the long-term evolution of our billing architecture—supporting new pricing model launches, complex usage rating schemes, and financial system integrations. Your attention to detail, technical versatility, and cross-functional mindset ensure our revenue pipeline remains scalable, compliant, and friction-free.

 What to expect

•
 Billing Infrastructure & Administration: Serve as the hands-on technical owner of our BillingPlatform environment, configuring catalogs, price cards, usage rating rules, and automated invoice schedules.

•
 System Operations & Maintenance: Own ongoing platform health, including system updates, pricing launches, recurring bill-run troubleshooting, sync exception handling, and root-cause issue resolution.

•
 Data Ingestion & Analysis: Utilize SQL to perform data validation, rating engine auditing, and operational reporting while collaborating with Engineering to receive mediated usage data (e.g., via DigitalRoute or Kafka).

•
 Integrations & API Management: Maintain and optimize clean, API-driven integrations connecting BillingPlatform to upstream CRMs (e.g. Salesforce), downstream ERP/GL tools (e.g., NetSuite), and payment gateways (e.g., Stripe).

•
 Revenue Recognition Alignment: Partner closely with Accounting to ensure system rating rules, revenue schedules, and general ledger mappings satisfy ASC 606 and IFRS 15 compliance standards.

•
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Gather technical and operational requirements directly from Accounting, Finance, Sales Ops, and Product teams, translating their vision into sustainable platform configuration.

•
 Data Integrity & Migration: Maintain billing data continuity and manage subscription data updates or migrations without disrupting ongoing financial operations or revenue recognition flows.

 What you bring

•
 Q2C Platform Experience: Proven hands-on experience configuring and administering enterprise Quote-to-Cash or billing platforms (e.g., Zuora, Salesforce Revenue Cloud/CPQ, NetSuite Billing, Aria Systems, or BillingPlatform).

•
 Data & Technical Skills: Strong proficiency with SQL for querying and auditing billing data, alongside a solid grasp of REST APIs, webhooks, and ETL workflows.

•
 Modern Pricing Expertise: Experience supporting complex SaaS or infrastructure pricing models—such as PLG, hybrid commitment-plus-usage, tiered rates, and consumption-based/metered billing.

•
 Revenue Recognition Knowledge: Practical understanding of rev rec fundamentals (ASC 606 / IFRS 15) and how accounting rules dictate billing engine design.

•
 Cross-Functional Communication: Ability to bridge technical language and financial business logic, effectively collaborating with engineering teams and accounting stakeholders alike.

•
 Problem Solving & Troubleshooting: A methodical approach to diagnosing system sync errors, rating anomalies, and integration edge cases to ensure operational continuity.

 Bonus points

•
 Experience with DigitalRoute mediation software or Kafka event-stream data intake

•
 Previous exposure to cloud infrastructure, PaaS, or developer-platform usage metrics

•
 Background supporting system migrations from implementation partners into internal teams

Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the United States . Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

London or UK Remote | £110,000 - £125,000 + Equity + Benefits | Hear from the team ✨

⭐Our Design team

We’re a team of 115+ designers, researchers, and brand experts led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Product Design is the largest discipline within the design organisation, with designers working in tight-knit squads alongside researchers, product managers, and engineers to solve real customer problems at scale.

We design for the "magic moments"

We’ve built a bank that feels human, not just functional. Our product is our personality. We blend research, empathy, and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.

Right now, we’re growing fast and looking for passionate designers to shape Monzo’s future and there’s a huge opportunity to make your mark.

You’ll play a key role by...

  • Setting the long-term design vision and leading large, end-to-end design projects in ambiguous problem spaces across wide product areas.
  • Navigating tradeoffs and guiding strategic decisions in an opinionated way.
  • Continuing to raise the bar for design craft and product excellence at Monzo, ensuring your work is a benchmark for quality and innovation across the organisation and our industry.
  • Partnering with cross-functional leaders to define and execute product strategies that translate into actionable plans you help build and ship.
  • Proactively addressing systemic challenges, reducing complexity, and creating better conditions for teams to deliver impactful work.
  • Acting as a visible ambassador for Design, sharing your work and its impact across the company to maintain Design’s place at the heart of Monzo.
  • Mentoring and levelling up designers across the discipline, fostering a culture of growth, collaboration, and belonging.

We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You’re an expert in your craft, with deep expertise in a specific design discipline and strong foundational skills across all areas of product design.
  • You have a proven track record of delivering high-impact design work that drives customer outcomes, influences company metrics, and achieves commercial goals.
  • You’ll have excellent visual, UI and interaction skills, and the ability to think through complex interaction design. 
  • You’re curious about continuing to develop your craft and keep learning about new tools, ways of working, and technology.
  • You thrive in ambiguity, leading teams to deliver in complex, fast-changing environments while maintaining a high bar for quality.
  • You’re a strategic thinker who can shape product direction across multiple areas and translate organisational goals into clear, actionable plans.
  • You’re a natural collaborator, skilled at working cross-functionally to improve ways of working and deliver greater value for customers and the business.
  • You’re a role model for resilience, rational decision-making, and effective communication, even in challenging circumstances.
  • You’re passionate about growing and shaping the Design team, whether through hiring, onboarding, or creating resources that scale your impact across the organisation.
  • You’re pragmatic and proactive, always looking for ways to improve Design’s impact at Monzo while balancing the need to “get the job done”.

What’s in it for you

£110,000 - £125,000 + Equity

✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.

✅ We can sponsor your visa.

This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

£1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more!

The application journey has 3 key steps

  • 30 minute call with our Recruiter, Tom
  • 1-hour craft interview where you’ll present a single case study to 2 members of our Design team
  • 2 x 45-minute interviews covering Leadership & Values and Strategy & Impact

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. 

#LI-TR1

#LI-Remote

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage

title: Cleaning Operative
description:
Job Title: Cleaning Operative  

Actual Annual Salary: £9,008 - £9,161 Based on hours and working weeks

Full Time Equivalent Salary: £25,949 - £26,392 (CLF Grade Aii) Based on full time and all year round 

Contract Type: Permanent 

Hours: Part time, 15 hours per week, Monday to Friday/Term time only Plus Insets 

Additional Information: This role requires availability from 4:00pm to 7:00pm, Monday to Friday, providing support during afternoon and early evening hours. 

Provisional Start Date: As soon as possible (Subject to completion of pre-employment checks) 

An opportunity to help create a clean, safe, and welcoming environment where students and staff can thrive. 

As a Cleaning Operative at City Academy Bristol, you will play an important role in maintaining high standards of cleanliness across the academy. Working as part of a dedicated team, you will help ensure that learning spaces, communal areas, and facilities are clean, safe, and well-presented for students, staff, and visitors. Your work will directly contribute to creating a positive environment that supports learning and well-being. 

You will be responsible for cleaning designated areas to a high standard, including sweeping, mopping, vacuuming, dusting, waste disposal, and replenishing consumables. You'll use cleaning equipment and products safely and effectively, following health and safety procedures and COSHH guidance. Working both independently and collaboratively, you will help maintain an efficient cleaning service while responding flexibly to the changing needs of the academy. 

About you: 

You will: 

  • Be committed to maintaining a clean, safe, and welcoming environment for all students, staff, and visitors. 
  • Have knowledge of basic cleaning methods, equipment, and materials. 
  • Be able to follow processes, procedures, and instructions accurately and consistently. 
  • Understand the importance of health and safety and be able to work in accordance with COSHH guidelines and academy procedures. 
  • Demonstrate excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks effectively. 
  • Be able to work independently with minimal supervision while also contributing positively as part of a team. 
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with colleagues, students, visitors, and external contractors when required. 
  • Take pride in delivering high standards of work and contributing to continuous improvement. 
  • Be reliable, flexible, and adaptable in responding to both routine tasks and ad hoc requirements. 
  • Be committed to inclusion, equality of opportunity, and supporting the academy's positive culture and values. 
  • Maintain confidentiality and demonstrate professionalism when handling sensitive information. 
  • Be committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. 
  • Ideally have previous cleaning experience, particularly within a school or educational environment, although this is not essential. 

This role offers the opportunity to be part of a supportive team that takes pride in maintaining a high-quality environment for the whole academy community, helping every student to succeed in a safe and welcoming setting. 

Applicants are advised to refer to the full requirements of the role in the attached job description and person specification, prior to submitting an application. 

About City Academy:  

City Academy Bristol is a vibrant, diverse and dynamic academy in the centre of Bristol. We provide an inclusive and accessible education, which transforms future opportunities for young people, their families and the community.  

We are a well-positioned and well-connected academy with direct connection to the developments in Temple Quarter and key economic areas of east and central Bristol.  

Why work at CLF? 

We are a diverse and inclusive community of 37 academies across five cluster regions in the South West that is committed to excellence and making a positive impact. Our people bring unique perspectives, but we’re all driven by a shared moral purpose and a passion for making a positive impact, whether in a teaching, leadership or support role. We’re proud to foster a culture where everyone can thrive, feel valued, and make a meaningful difference to the lives of others.    

We are an equal opportunity employer and proud to serve a diverse student population and our communities. We strongly believe that representation matters. Over 73% of the students who attend City Academy Bristol are from global majority groups, so we particularly encourage applicants from those groups in order to represent the students we serve, as well as wider underrepresented groups including gender, transgender, age disability, sexual orientation or religion. 

We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. Job share, part-time and flexible working opportunities will be considered. 

What we can offer you: 

  • Access to a generous pension through the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS).  
  • Generous annual leave. 
  • A comprehensive induction and ongoing commitment to wellbeing and career progression, through a range of training, apprenticeships and in-role/wider-trust development opportunities.  
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme.  
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs.  
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay.  
  • Additional benefits like cycle to work scheme, on-site parking plus many more! 

Recruitment timeline: 

  • Closing Date: 27 September 2026 @11.59pm 
  • Shortlisting Date: 28 September 2026 
  • Interview Date: 06 October 2026 

We welcome visits from potential candidates. If you would like to arrange a school visit prior to the closing date, please contact the academy/site directly to arrange a suitable appointment. 

As part of our commitment to Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), we do not accept CVs – a full education and employment history must be provided through our application form.  

Skilled Worker visas cannot be sponsored through this role, as it does not meet the requirements set out by government.  

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, should we receive a high level of interest in the role. Therefore, candidates are advised to apply at their earliest convenience to avoid missing out. 

As a Disability Confident Committed Employer, we are dedicated to equity and inclusion and commit to interviewing applicants with a disability who meet the essential criteria. We aim to provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process, and support employees throughout their employment. If you have a disability, are neurodivergent, or require any adjustments to support you through the application or interview process please let us know how we can assist.

Job Title: Higher Level Teaching Assistant 

Actual Annual Salary: £24,827 - £27,085 Based on hours and working weeks. 

Full Time Equivalent Salary: £33,009 - £36,011 (CLF Grade D) Based on Full Time hours, All year round. 

Contract Type: Permanent

Additional role info: Working Pattern - Monday to Friday, 6.5 hours per day

Are you an experienced Teaching Assistant looking for the next role in your classroom career: 

Herons’ Moor Academy is seeking a Higher Level Teaching Assistant (HLTA) to complement the work of teachers and play a key role in supporting students’ academic, personal and social development. This role will support Years 1-5 with a mixture of class support and PPA cover. 

The successful candidate will take responsibility for planning and delivering agreed learning activities under an appropriate system of supervision. This may include leading lessons for individuals, small groups or whole classes within an agreed framework, as well as providing targeted support for specific students or groups. 

Working closely with SENCO, class teachers and SLT, the HLTA will support students to access the curriculum, engage positively with their learning and achieve their full potential. The role requires the use of effective strategies and approaches informed by significant experience, specialist knowledge and professional expertise. 

The HLTA will make a measurable contribution to student attainment, progress and social and emotional wellbeing, with a wider impact on the learning environment and outcomes of students. They will also contribute to the development of colleagues by supporting, coaching and sharing effective practice. 

This is a key role for an experienced practitioner who can work confidently with students across a range of needs, take initiative and deliver high-quality learning and support with a clear focus on positive outcomes. 

About you: 

You will have: 

  • an understanding of classroom roles and responsibilities and how HLTAs support students in their learning. 
  • demonstrable, recent experience working as a highly effective/ skilled Teaching Assistant, HLTA or a role of equivalent skill level and requirement 
  • gained HLTA status, or equivalent qualification, or experience to demonstrate consistent ability to operate at this level.  
  • good literacy and numeracy competency (evidenced by GCSE Maths and English at grade C or above, equivalent qualifications or experience). 
  • the ability to engage students and manage behaviour on a one to one or small group basis. 
  • strong interpersonal skills, in particular with the ability to demonstrate empathy and active listening. 
  • good planning and organisational skills, specifically with regard to learning activities and support materials. 

Applicants are advised to refer to the full requirements of the role in the attached job description and person specification, prior to submitting an application.

Our community of children, parents, relatives, colleagues and other local community groups works closely together to ensure our children learn in an environment where they are filled with joy, confidence, and a strong sense of agency and feel safe to try new experiences and explore concepts of learning in a deeper way.

We are a diverse and inclusive community of 37 academies across five cluster regions in the South West that is committed to excellence and making a positive impact. Our people bring unique perspectives, but we’re all driven by a shared moral purpose and a passion for making a positive impact, whether in a teaching, leadership or support role. We’re proud to foster a culture where everyone can thrive, feel valued, and make a meaningful difference to the lives of others. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and proud to serve a diverse student population and our communities. We strongly believe that representation matters and so encourage applications from underrepresented and global majority groups including ethnicity, gender, transgender, age, disability, sexual orientation or religion. 

We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. Job share, part-time and flexible working opportunities will be considered. 

What we can offer you:

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Headquarters: Spain, remote

 Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

 Vonage Communications APIs

 As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure, allowing them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel, including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more.

 Why this role matters

 As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the trusted advisor and strategic partner for a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving platform adoption, long-term value, and revenue growth. This role demands a strong technical foundation; you must be fluent in APIs, comfortable in developer-facing conversations, and ideally bring hands-on experience from the CPaaS industry. You don’t just bridge the gap between technical complexity and business outcomes, you live in both worlds simultaneously.

 Your key responsibilities

• Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic enterprise accounts, building multi-threaded relationships from developers and product teams to C-suite executives

• Act as a credible technical voice in customer conversations, reviewing integration architectures, troubleshooting API implementations, and advising on best practices across Vonage’s full product portfolio (SMS, Voice, WhatsApp, RCS, Video, Verify ... )

• Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), proactively identify risks to customer health, and partner cross-functionally with Technical Experts, Product, and Engineering to resolve complex challenges

• Own revenue and direct margin growth for your book of business, forecasting accurately and executing retention and expansion strategies

• Develop outcome-driven success plans aligned to each customer’s business objectives , driving measurable platform adoption and long-term ROI

• Identify and develop upsell and cross-sell opportunities by connecting customer use cases to new or underutilised capabilities, working closely with Sales using usage data, health scores, and engagement metrics

• Collaborate with Technical Solutions Managers (TSMs) within a pod model for complex solutioning and escalations, while retaining full ownership of commercial outcomes

 What you'll bring

 Required:

• Fluent English and German/French is a must

• 5+ years of experience in Technical Account Management, Customer Success, or a similar strategic customer-facing role with a strong technical background in APIs or developer-facing products

• Deep, hands-on knowledge of CPaaS or API platforms: messaging (SMS, WhatsApp Business Platform, RCS), Voice/VoIP, Video, and Authentication/Verify solutions

• Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and software integration patterns, comfortable reading API documentation and engaging in technical troubleshooting alongside customers

• Demonstrated track record of managing and growing complex enterprise accounts with significant ARR responsibility

• Exceptional communication skills, able to hold in-depth technical conversations with developers and engineers, and translate those same concepts clearly for business and executive audiences

• Data-driven mindset, proficient in using customer health scores, usage analytics, and engagement metrics to identify risk and growth opportunities (Salesforce, Gainsight, or equivalent)

• Proven ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder environments and drive alignment across competing priorities

 Experience we consider a plus:

• Direct experience at a CPaaS provider (e.g., Vonage, Twilio, Sinch, Infobip, MessageBird) - this is a strong differentiator

• Familiarity with conversational AI, chatbot platforms, or omnichannel engagement strategies

• Knowledge of VoIP, SIP, or WebRTC protocols

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field

 How you'll benefit

• Opportunity to make a significant impact on strategic customer experiences and business growth.

• Competitive salary and meaningful career growth opportunities.

• Private Medical Insurance (Adeslas).

• Group Pension Plan (Generali).

• Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident (VidaCaixa).

• Ericsson Care Line.

• Discretionary Time Off (DTO).

 #LI-MW1
 There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

 To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice .

 Who we are:

 Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

title: Head of Physical Education
location: St Albans, East of England, GB
description:
Core Purpose of Head of Physical Education

To lead the Physical Education department with drive and imagination during the next phase of its development.

The Head of PE Department is responsible for making clear and effective decisions about: planning, implementing and evaluating the curriculum and extra-curriculum; leading and managing teaching and non-teaching staff; and organising department resources. To have overall responsibility for the standard of students’ work, outcomes and behaviour in the department.

PE is currently taught throughout the school including in the sixth form. Students enjoy 4 hours a fortnight at Key Stage 3&4 and we also deliver GCSE and A Level Physical Education.

The ability to teach Key Stage 3 / 4 Mathematics or Science as a second subject would also be desirable.

Physical Education facilities at Townsend as followings: Large playing fields with four full-sized pitches for football / rugby, a floodlit MUGA the size of 3 tennis courts, indoor swimming pool, dance studio, small gymnasium and 6 tennis courts. We currently have submitted planning permission for a 4 badminton court sports hall with two classrooms and a gym. We have also been identified by the Football Foundation as a site for a 3G full-sized astro-turf pitch. These are projects we hope to bring to reality in the next two years.

Students at Townsend benefit from a range of co-curricular clubs, house competitions and the district and country competition structure.

The successful candidate will be committed to high academic standards, and have a full appreciation of the importance of Personal, Social and Health Education. They will have the drive and creative flair to ensure participation and success in Physical Education continue to grow in the coming years so that Townsend becomes well-known for its provision and prowess in this physical activity.

About the Role:

  • To ensure the school’s PE curriculum enables all our students to achieve to the very best of their ability.

  • To secure and sustain high quality teaching, learning and assessment in PE. Leading moderation and standardisation of coursework across the range of qualifications offered by the department.

  • To organise the effective grouping of students and allocation of classes to teachers.

  • Planning practical curriculum courses to make the best use of facilities available within the constraints of the school calendar.

  • To routinely undertake self-evaluation of the performance of the department and use this to inform improvement planning and guide short, medium and long-term decisions.

  • To ensure that the schemes of work and resources used for the teaching of PE are high quality, appropriate and accessible and secure good progress for students of all abilities and backgrounds.

  • To ensure consistent record keeping and data analysis across the department in order to identify and intervene to address underachievement of individuals or identified groups

  • To use department meetings effectively.

  • To support the professional development needs of members of the department and support the development of new and student teachers where relevant

  • To line manage members of the department.

  • To work with staff, students and parents and use the school’s systems to manage student behaviour and to reward effort and achievement in the department.

  • To promote PE and to maintain a high profile for the subject and the department in the school and district.

  • To represent the PE Department at meetings inside and outside the school.

  • To liaise with key staff such as the SENCO, Exams Officer, the Pastoral Team and SLT to ensure that the needs of students are best met, and the department contributes towards the smooth running of the school.

  • To plan effective use of the department resources ensuring that they provide value for money and manage the department budget.

  • To ensure the department offers an excellent range of co-curricular activities including: House sport and inter school competitions at district, county and national levels.

  • To oversee the day-to-day work of the PE Department including ensuring cover work is set if required.

    • About the School

    Townsend Church of England School is a small, inclusive and friendly 11-18 school with approximately 750 students, including a Sixth Form.

    • Rated Good by Ofsted and Outstanding in SIAMS

    • Located on a beautiful, green site between St Albans and Harpenden

    • Serving a diverse and vibrant community across Hertfordshire and beyond

    Our ethos is rooted in our Christian vision of “Love Your Neighbour”, which underpins our commitment to kindness, respect and ambition for every student. While we are a Church school, we welcome applications from candidates of all faiths and none.

    Led by our Headteacher, Mr Anthony Flack, the school is on an exciting journey to become “the first choice secondary school for all.”👉 View our School Prospectus

    For further information or to arrange an informal conversation, please contact: recruitment@townsend.herts.sch.uk. Please submit your application to: Mr Anthony Flack, Headteacher, Townsend CofE School, High Oaks, St Albans, Hertfordshire, AL3 6DR online or via recruitment@townsend.herts.sch.uk

    Townsend CofE School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. All appointments are subject to enhanced DBS checks, satisfactory references, and pre-employment safeguarding checks, including an online search in line with Keeping Children Safe in Education guidance.

We do this to ensure that the school acts in accordance with its obligations set out in Keeping Children Safe in Education.

description:
Year 4 Class Teacher - Corpus Christi Catholic Primary School  

Full Time, Maternity Cover until 21st June 2027, or return of postholder 

Salary: M3-M6, £37,101 - £45,352 per annum   

Start Date: Monday 2nd November 2026

Behind every confident child is a teacher who believed in them first - the teacher who offers encouragement at just the right moment, celebrates every success, and occasionally helps solve the mystery of a missing jumper five minutes before home time.

At Corpus Christi, teaching is about more than delivering a curriculum. It’s about inspiring curiosity, nurturing confidence and creating a classroom where children feel safe to try, question, succeed - and occasionally laugh at the little surprises that come with learning.

Corpus Christi is a caring, friendly and ambitious school where happy children discover a genuine love of learning. Guided by our values of Believe, Hope and Trust, we nurture independent thinkers and lifelong learners who are confident in their abilities, respectful of others and ready to take on the world.

We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic Class Teacher who wants to make a real difference and be part of a supportive, welcoming, and values-driven school community.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is an excellent classroom practitioner with high expectations for every child
  • Can turn learning into an engaging and meaningful experience that sparks curiosity
  • Brings creativity, energy and warmth to their teaching
  • Builds strong, positive relationships with pupils, families and colleagues
  • Believes every child deserves to feel valued, challenged and successful
  • Is reflective, motivated and committed to continual professional growth
  • Enjoys working collaboratively and contributing to wider school life
  • Has a passion for education, shaping young minds, and the ability to locate lost jumpers at record speed!
  • Understands that great teaching often involves equal parts planning, encouragement and patience.

At Corpus Christi, you will find:

  • Children who are enthusiastic, kind and eager to learn
  • A genuinely supportive and collaborative staff team
  • A school where wellbeing and professional trust are valued
  • Opportunities to develop leadership and curriculum expertise
  • A strong sense of community where every member is known and valued

Corpus Christi Catholic Primary School is proud to be part of The Dunstan Catholic Educational Trust, offering excellent professional development and collaboration across a family of schools throughout the South West.

If you are a teacher who understands that great teaching is built on relationships, high expectations and those everyday moments that help children grow in confidence and character, we would love to hear from you.

We welcome and encourage visits from prospective applicants. Please contact our School Office Team on 01934 621919 or send an email to office@cc.thedcet.com to arrange a visit.  

Closing date: 9am, Monday 5th October 2026

Interview date: w/c 12th October 2026.

The Trust is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people, this role involves directly working with children and significant contact with children, and therefore we expect all staff and volunteers to share the same commitment. Please ensure a full work history is completed in your application form including any gaps of employment. Applicants will be required to complete satisfactory enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service check for this post prior to commencement. This post is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act (ROA) 1974. The Trust is an equal opportunities employer.

If successfully shortlisted the HR Department will also be conducting an individual online search of your ‘name, education and employment’, to demonstrate due diligence following ‘Keeping Children Safe in Education’ guidance. The search will not form part of the actual shortlisting process and any concerns arising from the search will be discussed directly with you.

title: Technical Delivery Manager
description:
Join the Aristocrat Interactive team as a Technical Delivery Manager and play a key role in delivering the next generation of our enterprise data platform. Collaborating with Engineering, Architecture, Product, and Business teams, you will lead complex technical and customer initiatives. These initiatives support data-driven decision making across Aristocrat Interactive.

You will coordinate cross-functional delivery and lead all aspects of technical interdependencies. You will manage delivery risks and ensure projects meet deadlines, scope, and quality requirements. This role requires someone who is equally comfortable working with engineering teams on technical delivery as they are presenting progress and risks to senior leadership.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex technical initiatives across the Data Platform portfolio.


  • Own project planning, execution, tracking, and delivery while ensuring alignment with business priorities.


  • Build and maintain detailed delivery plans, achievements, RAID logs, and dependency maps across several engineering groups.


  • Partner closely with Engineering Managers, Architects, Product Managers, and Data Engineering teams to coordinate successful execution.


  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and release planning where required.


  • Manage cross-team dependencies and proactively identify delivery risks, blockers, and mitigation strategies.


  • Translate business objectives into actionable technical workstreams alongside engineering and build groups.


  • Coordinate releases across multiple teams, ensuring technical readiness and successful production deployments.


  • Track project health through delivery metrics, achievements, and benchmarks, providing regular status reporting to leadership and steering committees.


  • Drive continuous improvement of delivery processes, governance, estimation practices, and Agile ways of working.


  • Support resource planning, capacity management, and prioritization across concurrent initiatives.


  • Ensure delivery aligns with security, compliance, governance, and operational requirements.


  • Develop collaboration across geographically distributed engineering teams while promoting accountability and delivery excellence.

What We're Looking For

  • A demonstrated ability leading technical software delivery, engineering programs, or enterprise technology projects.


  • Proven experience delivering complex, cross-functional technology initiatives involving multiple engineering teams.


  • Strong understanding of modern software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and DevOps practices.


  • Experience working closely with software engineering, cloud platforms, data engineering, and architecture teams.


  • Ability to understand technical concepts and effectively communicate with both technical and non-technical collaborators.


  • Demonstrated success managing technical dependencies, delivery risks, release planning, and collaborator expectations.


  • Strong organizational and planning skills with experience managing multiple concurrent initiatives.


  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and executive reporting skills.


  • Experience with Agile delivery tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar.


  • Familiarity with project management and collaboration tools including Smartsheet, Monday.com, Microsoft Project, and Microsoft Office Suite.


  • Experience working in cloud-based environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and data platform initiatives is highly desirable.


  • Experience within regulated industries or enterprises in SaaS environments is considered an advantage.

Preferred Experience

  • Delivery of enterprise data platforms, analytics platforms, or data engineering solutions.


  • Experience coordinating large-scale platform migrations or modernization initiatives.


  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, release management, and software deployment practices.


  • Knowledge of data governance, security, and compliance principles.


  • Experience working within globally distributed engineering organizations.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

 About the Role

 As a Customer Success Manager at Abnormal AI, you will serve as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams, focusing on successful onboarding, adoption, and ongoing value delivery. You will build and nurture strong customer relationships, align on business goals, and drive measurable outcomes through best practice adoption and strategic planning. You will proactively identify opportunities and risks to help customers maximize their investment and contribute valuable feedback for product improvements. Your role involves collaboration with cross-functional teams and maintaining customer satisfaction and retention.

 Who you are

• Skilled at building trust and maintaining relationships with stakeholders at various organizational levels, including executives

• Action-oriented, analytical, and collaborative in approach to customer success and issue resolution

• Dedicated to delivering measurable customer value and ensuring satisfaction throughout the customer lifecycle

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, comfortable handling both strategic discussions and technical conversations

• Solid technical understanding of SaaS products, including internet technologies, networking, and email security solutions

• Proven track record of driving product adoption and supporting long-term customer growth

 What you will do

• Act as the main point of contact for assigned customers, developing strategic relationships and guiding platform adoption and success planning

• Deliver regular business reviews (QBRs/EBRs), clearly communicating ROI and aligning on success metrics to support retention and expansion

• Understand customers’ industries, goals, and challenges to provide tailored recommendations and align internal and external stakeholders on success objectives

• Promote awareness and usage of key platform features, provide ongoing education, and identify opportunities for expanded adoption

• Proactively monitor customer health, manage escalations, and collaborate with Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales teams to resolve issues and share actionable insights

• Maintain expert knowledge of the product roadmap and communicate relevant updates and enhancements to customers

• Coordinate with internal teams to develop and execute customer success plans, addressing risks before they impact engagement or satisfaction

 Must Haves

• 5+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS, with at least 3+ years in Customer Success, TAM, or support roles

• Proven ability to manage large customer portfolios and develop long-term relationships, including at the executive level

• Excellent communication, presentation, and organizational skills, capable of managing both strategic and technical conversations effectively

• Strong problem-solving skills and experience resolving escalations while maintaining a positive customer experience

• Proficiency with CRM and case management tools such as Salesforce and Jira

• Technical proficiency related to internet technologies, networking, and email security products

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience

title: Senior Systems Engineer (Identity and Access)
description:
Headquarters: U.S. Remote

 About Flexport:

 At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

 The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

 The Opportunity:

 Flexport IT is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer (Identity & Access) . In this role, you will design, implement, and administer our Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions to ensure secure, efficient user lifecycle management.

 While you are our resident Okta expert, you are also a high-level IT generalist. You will oversee our broader SaaS ecosystem (Google Workspace, Slack, Jira) and endpoint management infrastructure (Jamf, Intune). Your expertise will drive automation, protect sensitive data, mitigate security risks, and maintain compliance in a heavily regulated industry.

 You will continually strive towards automation of toil. If you are still manually doing the same operational tasks 18 months from now, something has gone wrong. Flexport’s book of business is growing fast, but the promise of technology is that we can grow our business faster than our headcount. The automation you build will be a key factor in that effort.

 You Will

• IAM Architecture: Design, implement, and maintain the end-to-end lifecycle of Identity and Access Management platforms.

• Okta & Directory Trust: Administer Okta, directory services, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and advanced password management.

• SaaS Operations: Manage core collaboration tools including Google Workspace, Microsoft O365, Slack, and Jira/Confluence.

• Unified Endpoint Management: Oversee our global fleet of Mac and Windows devices using Jamf and MS Intune.

• Lifecycle Automation: Build automated workflows for provisioning, deprovisioning, and application access.

• Identity Governance: Establish role-based access control (RBAC), entitlement reviews, and access certification processes.

• SSO Integration: Lead the technical onboarding of new SaaS applications for Single Sign-On (SSO).

• Security Partnership: Collaborate closely with the Security team to embed security best practices into our IT infrastructure.

• Documentation & Roadmaps: Author technical operating procedures, engineering roadmaps, and compliance policies.

• Operations Support: Provide high-tier technical leadership and escalation support for complex IT operations.

 You Should Have

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in IAM systems engineering paired with broad IT infrastructure management.

• Okta Expertise: Deep, hands-on mastery of Okta configuration, policy creation, and application integration.

• Core Protocols: Strong knowledge of IAM standards including SAML, SCIM, OAuth, OIDC, IGA, RBAC, and LDAP .

• Automation Skills: Experience with scripting (e.g., Python, Bash, or PowerShell) and Okta Workflows to automate IT tasks.

• SaaS & Endpoint Ecosystem: Proven track record managing Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, Jamf (macOS), and Intune (Windows).

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical engineering experience.

• Compliance Mindset: A "compliance-first" attitude to navigate the rigorous requirements of a heavily regulated industry.

• Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving abilities paired with strong collaborative and interpersonal communication.

description:
AI Engineer - FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer)

Location: United Kingdom - Remote (must be based in the UK for this role)

Mission

The AI Forward Deployed Engineering (AI FDE) team is a highly specialized customer-facing AI team at Databricks. We deliver professional services engagements to help our customers build and productionize first-of-its-kind AI applications. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations, as well as support internal subject matter expert (SME) teams. We view our team as an ensemble: we look for individuals with strong, unique specializations to improve the overall strength of the team. This team is the right fit for you if you love working with customers, teammates, and fueling your curiosity for the latest trends in GenAI, LLMOps, and ML more broadly.

We welcome remote applicants located near our offices. Preferred locations: London (UK),

Reporting to: Senior Manager - AI FDE, EMEA

The impact you will have:

  • Develop cutting-edge GenAI solutions, incorporating the latest techniques from Databricks AI research to solve customer problems
  • Own production rollouts of consumer and internally facing GenAI applications
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers across a variety of domains
  • Present at conferences such as Data + AI Summit, recognized as a thought leader internally and externally
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with the product and engineering teams to influence priorities and shape the product roadmap

More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. title: Software Architect
description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD94957

Position Overview 

At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive. 

Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it. 

Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture — APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together — spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role. 

The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma. 

This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build — through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance — rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to your strengths and organizational need. 

Responsibilities 

  • API Design & Evolution: Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services — resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract. 

  • System Architecture: Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows. 

  • Schema Design & Evolution: Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) — including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks. 

  • Standards & Governance: Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews. 

  • Prototyping & Feasibility: Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption. 

  • Mentorship & Technical Leadership: Mentor engineers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams. 

  • Reliability & Performance: Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging). 

  • Communication: Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials. 

Minimum Qualifications 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 

  • 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration. 

  • Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience). 

  • Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design — including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies — as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required. 

  • Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns. 

  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management. 

  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams. 

  • Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders. 

  • Ability to collaborate with a global team. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. 

Core: 

  • Cloud Services: AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS). 

  • Distributed Systems: Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design. 

  • API & Service Design: REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation). 

  • Database Architecture: Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL). 

  • Observability/SRE: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services. 

Bonus: 

  • Semantic Technologies: Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs — particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM. 

  • BIM Expertise: Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems. 

  • AI Systems: RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering). 

  • Domain-Specific AI for AEC: BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing. 

  • Event-Driven Architectures: Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing. 

  • AEC Domain Knowledge: Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Domain onboarding is provided. 

About the Team 

The AEC Data team is building the AEC Data Model (AECDM) to enable better AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, Operations) outcomes through more useful, connected, and accessible data. Its scope spans data services and APIs, product and design-tool integrations, and lifecycle/asset data across multiple teams — enabling the seamless flow of information across Autodesk products and third-party integrations so that AEC professionals can make better decisions with better data. 

Why Join Us 

  • Shape the future of AEC data platforms and standards at an industry-leading company. 

  • Design systems and schemas used by millions of architects, engineers, and construction professionals worldwide. 

  • Collaborate with world-class software architects and engineers across Autodesk's AEC portfolio. 

  • Contribute to open standards and interoperability initiatives that benefit the entire industry. 

  • Join a team that values technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning. 

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

title: Senior Sales Engineer, Enterprise
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

description:
We are seeking to appoint an inspirational, professional Student Support Worker from November 2026. This non-teaching role would suit an individual who is able to provide appropriate academic, behavioural and pastoral support for students as well as build effective, positive relationships with students. The successful candidate will operate as part of a team of Student Support Workers who excel in promoting positive attitudes and behaviour at all times.   • Establish a systematic method of supporting students through effective and productive 1:1 sessions and group sessions.

  • Offer provision which supports students in achieving academic targets and goals, using assessment data as necessary.
  • Use knowledge of external services within the local area to provide appropriate support to individuals and families, including making referrals to appropriate agencies.
  • Protect children within the academy, ensuring that safeguarding takes place in an effective and timely manner, assessing the level of safeguarding needed within this element of your role.
  • Make decisions about whether concerns should be followed up through universal providers, early help assessment (EHA) or via a referral to child services.
  • Attend multi-agency meetings, both internally within the academy and on an external basis.
  • Adhere to government policies with relation to all aspects of the role, including safeguarding. This includes the identification and recognition of risk in an emotional, sexual, physical and neglectful context.
  • Create motivating and effective programmes to support pupils in a variety of areas.
  • Attend and take an active role in protecting students through attendance at multi-agency meetings in which representative identify local risks and issues for pupils of the academy.
  • Take an active role within the anti-bullying steering group within the academy.
  • Support and lead peer mentors within the academy effectively, ensuring that they play a key role in supporting students within the academy.
  • Manage workload by creating a week-in-view and keeping a diary of support offered to a variety of pupils.
  • Provide appropriate support to support colleagues with supervision of the Inclusion Centre as appropriate
  • Demonstrate effectiveness of the support provided through statistical data which evidences ‘closed’ support cases and ‘exited’ students.

title: School Estates Officer
description:
National Team

Thank you for your interest in joining Anthem. We are a dynamic organisation committed to supporting thousands of children and young people to achieve great things through one of our schools.

Anthem is one of the most established school trusts in the country, serving nearly 8,000 students across primary and secondary schools in the East Midlands, London and the Thames Valley. As a multi-academy trust, Anthem is first and foremost a school improvement organisation, committed to creating ambitious and successful schools where everyone thrives, guided by our values of integrity, collaboration and excellence.

Role purpose

To support the safe, clean, secure, and well-maintained operation of the school's premises and

facilities. The School Estates Officer will work as part of the premises team under the direction of the

School Estates Manager, carrying out a range of practical maintenance, cleaning support, grounds,

and security duties to ensure the school site is a safe, welcoming, and functional environment for

pupils, staff, and visitors.

Main duties and responsibilities

Health & Safety and Statutory Compliance

Carry out routine health and safety checks as directed by the School Estates Manager

(Secondary) or Regional Estates Manager (Primary) (e.g. fire door checks, emergency

lighting tests, water flushing records).

Report any health and safety hazards, defects, or maintenance issues to the School Estates

Manager promptly.

Follow all health and safety policies and procedures, including safe use of equipment and

hazardous substances (COSHH).

Participate in fire drills and support evacuation procedures as directed.

Maintain accurate records for all checks and tasks completed.

Estates and Facilities Management

Carry out routine maintenance and minor repairs across the school site as directed and within

the scope of competence (e.g. painting, basic joinery, replacing light bulbs, fixing fixtures and

fittings).

Set-up and takedown furniture, equipment, and rooms for school events, examinations,

lettings, and meetings as required.

Maintain the cleanliness and presentation of internal and external areas of the school site,

including corridors, toilets, changing rooms, and communal spaces, working alongside the

cleaning team as required.

Carry out grounds maintenance duties including litter picking, sweeping paths, clearing

drains, maintaining external areas, emptying bins and assisting with winter gritting/snow

clearance.

A place to thrive

Support the operation and basic maintenance checks of plant rooms, boiler rooms, and utility

systems under the direction of the School Estates Manager.

Take receipt of, move, and distribute deliveries and stock across the site.

Contractor Management

Sign in and direct contractors on site in accordance with school procedures.

Support the School Estates Manager in monitoring contractor activity and reporting any

concerns.

Risk Management and Reporting

Record and report any maintenance faults, defects, or safety concerns using the school's

reporting system.

Maintain accurate records for all premises activities, inspections, and tasks as directed.

Report any incidents or near misses on site to the School Estates Manager immediately.

General Responsibilities

Uphold and promote the trust's values, policies, and procedures at all times.

Maintain a professional and courteous manner when dealing with staff, pupils, parents,

contractors, and visitors.

Participate in training and development activities as required by the School Estates Manager

or Regional Estates Manager

Support the wider school community by assisting with school events, open evenings,

productions, and other activities that require premises assistance.

Manage and use tools, equipment, and materials responsibly and safely.

Undertake security arrangements such as opening and locking up the school site.

Carry out any other reasonable duties as directed by the School Estates Manager

(Secondary) or Regional Estates Manager (Primary), commensurate with the grade and

nature of the post. Including supporting local schools within the region with support and

capacity as identified.

Scope and Limitation

The principal responsibilities and tasks set out above are not intended to be exhaustive. The need for flexibility, accountability and team working is required. The post-holder is expected to carry out any other related duties that are within the employee's skills and abilities, commensurate with the post's grade and whenever reasonably instructed. The Trust is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment. All successful candidates will be subject to an enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service check. The successful candidate will have a right to work in the UK. Anthem Schools Trust uses standardised job titles across its schools to support consistency and career progression. The title of this role is School Estates Officer. Within the education sector and wider employment market, equivalent roles may also be referred to as Caretaker, Site Assistant, Facilities Assistant or similar. Employees may wish to reference these equivalent sector-recognised titles when describing their experience and responsibilities in job applications, CVs or professional profiles. The contractual title of the post remains School Estates Officer.

Benefits

As part of Anthem Schools Trust, staff benefit from a supportive working environment and access to a range of employee benefits, including health and wellbeing support, professional development opportunities and financial benefits.

Safeguarding

We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expect all staff, visitors and volunteers to share this commitment. All post holders are subject to an Enhanced DBS check, suitable references and other essential checks. Staff involved in recruitment and selection are trained in safer recruitment, and all staff and volunteers undertake child protection training.

  • You maintain up-to-date knowledge of safeguarding and child protection legislation, implementing these policies with consistency and care.

About us

At The King Alfred School, we are proud to provide a first-class education in a safe, happy and caring environment where every child is supported to reach their full potential. Our Somerset location offers strong transport links across Somerset and North Somerset, connecting our vibrant school community.

We foster an ethos built on kindness, ambition, resilience and mutual respect, which is reflected in our broad and balanced curriculum and high standards of student conduct. We feature a thriving Sixth Form centre, a dedicated Community Council and student leadership team, the student-led Jill Dando News Centre, and a strong track record of active involvement in our local community.
